verdict.rationale: Bolna's Mintlify-based API reference renders a live "Try it" runner on each endpoint, such as Create voice AI agent at POST /v2/agent, along with generated cURL and request samples. That is the interactive reference with runnable examples the story asks for. The unpublished OpenAPI file is a separate spec-publication concern and does not contradict the in-page runner. Missing for 10: hands-on confirmation that the runner executes live requests (its active state is inferred from the absence of a disabled-playground config), and independent corroboration beyond a single docs observation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Mintlify API reference renders a live "Try it" runner per endpoint (e.g. Create voice AI agent, POST https://api.bolna.ai/v2/agent) with generated cURL and request samples
